prompt: In 2024, assuming that their family has been in the same line of work since they took a surname, what is the major use of the product they make if their last name is Kalkbrenner?
answer: “Kalkbrenner” literally means **“lime burner”**—someone who burns limestone to make **quicklime (lime)**. The product’s major modern industrial use is **steelmaking**, where lime acts as a flux to remove impurities from molten iron and steel.
